title: GeoSpec engine release provenance
description: Provenance record published with every @taucad/geospec-engine release. Records its version, release date, Apache-2.0 license, and artifact digests.

version.description: SemVer version of the release this record describes.

releaseDate.description: UTC date the release was made available (ISO 8601 date).

artifacts.description: Every published artifact in the release, with its digest.

path.description: Path of the artifact within the published package.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 digest of the artifact bytes.
